items.title: Advisories in Five Months: Results from the Drupal AI Security Initiative
items.summary: Between June and October 2026, the Drupal Security Team published more advisories than in the previous 30 months combined. Five months into our SEIR grant, our data shows the shifting economics of discovery and why funding a complete workflow kept our volunteer process moving.
items.interpretation: 这类事件往往暴露真实瓶颈：算力、数据中心和安全性才是大规模落地的关键变量，而不只是模型名称本身。
